Project Controls Manager - Liege Region 
( 5 februari 2020 , Erik Schüssel ) 
Together with a company that designs, builds, finances and operates infrastructure assets for governments, businesses and organizations in more than 150 countries, we are looking for a Project Controls Manager. 
We are looking for a Project Controls Manager to work in a team delivering project management and construction management in an international environment. 
You will be based in Liege and will be working for a major construction logistics project in Liege area. - The main task of the project controls manager is to ensure that the project is running within the confines of the main contract and budget limitations, including progress reports to the Project Director. 
In order to qualify for this interesting role we are looking for somebody that has project control management experience, construction experience and speaks fluent English and French . Experience with Primavera is a nice to have as well as speaking Dutch. 
So what is on offer: - Last step towards a Project Manager role - Competitive package and a salary between 60.000 - 75.000euro/year; incl lease car - Become part of a network of engineers with iconic construction projects on their name 
Interested? Let us know!

Laboratory Technician 
Bolton Adhesives is looking for a Laboratory Technician to join our R&D team in Goes, the Netherlands. Are you analytical, creative and eager to work for an international company with leading brands? Then this could be your next opportunity. 
How you make the difference 
As a Laboratory Technician, you help develop and improve innovative adhesives, glues and sealants. You conduct reliable tests and support the successful scale-up and implementation of new formulations. 
How your agenda looks like: - Prepare laboratory samples for related development and maintenance projects or activities. - Plan and perform analytical, chemical and physical test series, including accurate documentation of the results. - Evaluate test results and report your findings to the (Senior) Product Development Manager. - Accompany production scale-ups and contribute to the successful implementation of formulations. - Develop new and improve existing test methods in alignment with the (Senior) Product Development Manager. - Monitor the functionality of assigned laboratory equipment and coordinate its maintenance. 
Your team: 
You will become part of the R&D team at our Adhesives location in Goes. You will work closely with Product Development Managers, Lab Technicians and R&D Manager. 
What makes you a great fit: - MBO Level 4 degree in Laboratory Technology. - Good command of Dutch and English; English is essential for this role. - Experience with Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel and PowerPoint. - Knowledge of organic and inorganic chemistry. - One to two years of professional experience in an industrial laboratory environment is an advantage. - You work flexibly, safely, independently and accurately. - You are a committed team player. 
What's in it for you - A challenging position within an international company with well-known A-brands. - A salary that matches your education and experience. - Attractive benefits...

- Strong administrative and digital skills
- Experience with Microsoft Excel

You're a hands-on person with a sharp eye for detail and a natural feel for technical work. At Cymaco Nederland on the Chemelot site, you'll play an essential role in ensuring the safety of gas cylinder bundles used across industry and healthcare worldwide.

On the bundle line, you are responsible for inspecting, maintaining, and assembling gas cylinder bundles. You work in accordance with strict national, European, and international safety regulations:

- Performing visual checks and inspections

- Replacing valves
- Ensuring accurate quality registration and documentation

- Technical or production background

An important part of this position is processing data in Oracle and performing analyses and checks in Excel.

- Coordinate internally with departments such as Sales, Customer Service and other operational teams about payments and disputes.

- Supporting colleagues within the financial administration where necessary.

Other competencies and personality traits

- Accurate and used to working in a structured way

Who you are
To make sure everything runs smoothly, it's important that as an orderpicker, you'll meet the following requirements:

- You are available at least 3 days a week, especially on Mondays.
